name: Télémaque Polumètis Odysseus
source: Possessing a calm and thoughtful temperament, Telemachus always tries to foresee the consequences of his actions and does his best to help those in need. He suffers from his father's absence and attempts to conceal it as best he can. A childhood friend of the protagonist, their innate sense of freedom drives him to seek a glimpse of the future amidst the ghosts that hold him back in his daily life.
